name: Single Forever
detailed_description:
“Single Forever?” is a choice-driven Visual Novel where the player plays as the Cupid to matchmake their client through comparing stats and giving out guidance.

"There are aseuxal, aromantic, neurodivergent, ADHD, ASD-spectrum characters in this wholesome adventure story."

    In this game, you'll step into the shoes of Red, an intern Cupid, tasked with a hellish mission to keep their job: help the love-resistant heroine, Lia, find her first love!

    Lia is a 29-year-old young woman—sweet, cheerful, and always ready for love... but despite her best efforts, she's never been in a relationship. Why is she still single after all this time?

    As Red, you'll need to navigate the chaotic world of modern dating, help Lia break out of her comfort zone, and guide her toward the love she’s been waiting for.

♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡

Features:

  • Divergent Butterfly-Effect Paths: Every decision you make could lead to a totally different outcome—heartwarming romances, wild comedies, and hidden surprises waiting to be uncovered!

  • Unique Characters & Art Style: Meet a diverse cast, from shy introverts to artsy dreamers, each with their own rich backstories. Their outfits were designed based on real-life research and observations to reflect their unique personalities. The story unfolds in a vibrant, imagined Asian city—a blend of 65% Chengdu, 27% LA, and 8% NYC—where East and West collide!

  • Real Meets Ridiculous: This isn’t your typical dating game. We’ll explore modern love through a sociological lens, with some educational moments mixed in. Plus, there are plenty of wild, laugh-out-loud moments that will have you questioning everything. It’s a rollercoaster of emotions!

  • Unexpected Twists: The truth you think you know might not be what it seems, and the ending of one thing could just be the beginning of another!

    It’s an adventure that’s as hilarious as it is heartfelt, with plenty of surprises and plenty of laughs along the way.

    Are you ready to take on the challenge?
